reports.text:
This week felt uneven. When I only had to type the meaning of a word, I did fine, and the recognition cards were mostly okay. But whenever the app asked me to produce something myself, like a typed translation, a full sentence, a cloze typed or a spoken answer, I got nothing right. That part felt too hard.

I never saw the same word twice in one session, so nothing felt repetitive. Some words did come back on a later day, like forse, andare, sempre and dire, which helped.

What bothered me is that certo, tempo, vita, cose, visto, qualcuno, ciao and dio slipped away and no card ever asked about them. Also, 7 spoken answers went unheard, and one card didn't match any word I saved. That was frustrating.

This week was uneven for me. I played all seven days, and typed meaning felt easy: 23 right out of 24. Multiple choice and cloze choice were okay, but typed translation, say translation, cloze typed and sentence translation were brutal. I got none of them right. Recalling the Italian myself, with no options to lean on, is where I fall apart.

Speaking was frustrating too. The app did not hear 8 of my spoken answers, and 5 cards could not be matched to a saved word, which made some misses feel unfair.

I never got the same word twice in one session, so nothing felt repetitive. Words did come back after a few days, like uomo after 5 days, though some took too long. Meanwhile certo, tempo, vita, cose, visto, qualcuno, ciao, dio, dopo, adesso, bisogno and amico slipped away and no card asked about them. I'd like those back.

This week felt uneven. Letter tiles were easy, and I got every one of them right, but the harder cards hit me. I got none of the say-translation, typed-translation, sentence-translation or cloze cards right. Multiple choice went badly too, with only 1 of 4 right. So it was too easy in some places and too hard in others, and the app didn't seem to notice which was which.

I never saw the same word twice in one session, so nothing felt repetitive. Words did return on later days, like proprio after 9 days, volta and qualche after 5, and meglio, signore and modo after 4. That spacing felt about right.

What bothered me were the words I forgot that never came back: certo, tempo, vita, cose, visto, qualcuno, ciao, dio, dopo, adesso, bisogno, amico. I saved them and then nothing asked me about them. Also, 2 spoken answers weren't heard, and 6 cards couldn't be matched to a saved word.

This week I opened the app every single day, and that's the strange part: nothing happened. No sessions, no cards, nothing right, nothing wrong, and no new words saved. So I can't say it was too easy or too hard, because I never got a single question. There was no same word coming back again and again either, and no word returning on a later day.

What bothers me is the words I've forgotten and nobody asked me about: certo, tempo, vita, cose, visto, qualcuno, ciao, dio, dopo, adesso, bisogno, amico. These are common words, the kind I need all the time, and they just slipped away with no card to catch them. I'd expect the app to bring them back when I forget them. This week it didn't, and I felt stuck.

This week felt a bit too easy in one way and too thin in another. I played all seven days, but each time it was one short session, so I only got ten cards in total. I got six right, and the matching cards were the easiest for me. Letter tiles felt hardest, and I missed the one I got. Cloze choice was a coin flip.

I never saw the same word twice in a session, which was fine, no nagging repetition. The words that returned, like andare, ragazzi, grande and casa, came back after a long gap, and I did remember some of them.

What bothers me is the list of words I forgot that never got asked: certo, tempo, vita, cose, visto, qualcuno, ciao, dio, dopo, adesso, bisogno, amico. I wanted those back. I saved four new words, but old ones slipped away. One card also didn't match any word I had saved.

This week felt mixed, leaning hard. I played all seven days and got 52 right out of 89 cards, so it was not a disaster, but the harder card types hurt. Typed meaning was fine at 28 of 33, and multiple choice was okay at 11 of 15. Matching, letter tiles, typed translation and cloze were rough, and I got 0 on typed translation, cloze typed and sentence translation. Those felt too hard for words I only half know.

Repetition was not a problem. No word came up twice in one session, which was a relief. Old words did return, like forse after 31 days and fuori after 29, but those gaps were long.

What bothers me is the words I forgot that no card asked about: certo, tempo, vita, cose, visto, qualcuno, ciao, dio, dopo, adesso, bisogno, amico. They never came back. Also, 6 cards did not match any word I saved.

This week felt uneven. Typing things out was brutal: typed translation, cloze typed and sentence translation gave me nothing right, while typed meaning went well and matching was easy. Multiple choice was a coin toss at best, so the week was too hard on production and too easy on recognition.

I liked that words like vieni, andare and credo came back after many days, and that fits how I forget. But no word repeated within a session, so I never got a second try right away.

What bothered me most: certo, tempo, vita, cose, visto, qualcuno, ciao, dio, dopo, adesso, bisogno and amico slipped away and no card asked about them. I saved 25 new words, yet those forgotten ones never returned. Also, 16 cards couldn't be matched to a saved word, which seems odd.
